## Weekly Plan (Lectures)

The plan below is **tentative** and will be adjusted as the semester progresses. Slides marked *Lec n* are from [CS1100, IIT Madras](./cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/index.qmd), reused with permission — see [acknowledgements](./index.qmd#acknowledgements). Additional notes will be posted as we go.

| Week | Dates (Mon, Tue) | Topics | Materials |
|:---:|---|---|---|
| 01 | Aug 3, Aug 4 | Introduction: computer science, algorithms, computer hardware & software | [Lec 1](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec1.pdf) · [Lec 3](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec3.pdf) |
| 02 | Aug 10, Aug 11 | Number systems: decimal & binary; unsigned and signed integers (sign-magnitude, one's & two's complement) | Notes (TBP) |
| 03 | Aug 17, Aug 18 | Number systems (contd.): binary arithmetic, floating point; conversions. *Class Test-1 window opens Aug 19* | Notes (TBP) |
| 04 | Aug 24, Aug 25 | Programming types (declarative, imperative); structure of a C program; our first C program | [Lec 4](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec4.pdf) |
| 05 | Aug 31, Sep 1 | Compilation pipeline: source, assembly and object files, linker, loader; compiler vs. interpreter | [Lec 6](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec6.pdf) |
| 06 | Sep 7, Sep 8 | Data & expressions: literals, variables, identifiers, data types; operators, precedence; `printf`/`scanf` | [Lec 5](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec5.pdf) |
| 07 | Sep 14, Sep 15 | Control structures: boolean expressions, selection (`if`, `if-else`, `switch`) | [Lec 7](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec7.pdf) · [Lec 8](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec8.pdf) |
| 08 | Sep 21, Sep 22 | **Mid-Semester Examinations (Sep 18–23) — no classes** | — |
| 09 | Sep 28, Sep 29 | Iteration: `while`, `do-while`, `for`; worked examples (primes, GCD, min) | [Lec 9](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec9.pdf) · [Lec 12](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec12.pdf) · [Lec 14](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec14.pdf) |
| 10 | Oct 5, Oct 6 | Arrays: one-dimensional and character arrays; examples | [Lec 15](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec15.pdf) · [Lec 16](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec16.pdf) |
| 11 | Oct 12, Oct 13 | Strings and string processing; multi-dimensional arrays; matrix operations. *Class Test-2 window opens Oct 14* | [Lec 17](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec17.pdf) · [Lec 18](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec18.pdf) |
| 12 | Oct 19, Oct 20 | **Dussehra holidays — no classes** | — |
| 13 | Oct 26, Oct 27 | Functions and modular programming; scope; recursion | [Lec 19](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec19.pdf) · [Lec 20](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec20.pdf) · [Lec 24](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec24.pdf) |
| 14 | Nov 2, Nov 3 | Pointers; dynamic memory allocation (`malloc`, `calloc`, `realloc`, `free`) | [Lec 27](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec27.pdf) · [Lec 28](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec28.pdf) |
| 15 | Nov 9, Nov 10 | **Holidays (Govardhan Puja, Declared Holiday) — no classes** | — |
| 16 | Nov 16, Nov 17 | Function pointers; structures & unions; file and error handling; header files; applications and a brief of OOP; wrap-up | [Lec 29](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec29.pdf) · [Lec 30](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec30.pdf) · [Wrap-up](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/wrapping-up.pdf) |
